    "For horizon > 15 days, apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility and avoid overfitting to short-term noise.",
    "When true outcome drops below 65.00, reduce forecast by 3-5% to account for potential market correction.",
    "If sentiment history is flat (all 0.00), assume low volatility and adjust forecast to align with recent 10-day moving average."
